message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on facts: illegal logging (unlicensed felling of trees) in China. The crime is "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging) under the Criminal Law of PRC, Article 322 (or 324?). Actually Article 322: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的森林、珍贵、濒危树种或者在国家规定的禁伐期内采伐林木的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also there is "非法买卖林木罪" maybe. But the facts: unlicensed felling of trees, selling wood for 1590 yuan. So charge: "非法采伐林木罪". Possibly also "非法买卖林木罪" if selling. However Chinese law: "非法买卖林木罪" is Article 324: "非法买卖国家重点保护的森林、珍贵、濒危树种或者在国家规定的禁伐期内采伐的林木的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Here they sold wood from illegal logging. So could be both illegal logging and illegal sale. Usually prosecutors charge "非法采伐林木罪" for the act of cutting without permit. The sale may be considered part of same crime. Might be "非法采伐林木罪" only.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木罪<eoa>
